## Required checks

- [ ] I ran the relevant local verification commands.
- [ ] CI is expected to remain green.
- [ ] No duplicate authority was introduced.
- [ ] Identity and tenant context are preserved.
- [ ] Contract compatibility impact is documented.
- [ ] An ADR is included for material architecture changes.
- [ ] Documentation/navigation was updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, PHI, or private keys are included.
